title: Comparative Analysis of Multimodal Large Language Models GPT-4o and o1 vs Clinicians in Clinical Case Challenge Questions

live_model.evidence: Methods: 'Each GPT model (GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4 Omni, and o1) was accessed through the OpenAI API between August and December 2024'; Results: GPT-4 Turbo 82.1% of 1,426 questions.

prompt.location: Table 3 'Prompt template for GPT models' (system instruction + [Question] [Options] [All textual information])
prompt.note: Temperature 0.1, top-p 1.0; chat reset per question; images only given to GPT-4o and o1.

claim.location: Results (Figure 1A / Table 1 header): GPT-4 Turbo 82.1% on 1,426 Medscape case challenge questions

data.source: Medscape case challenges (https://reference.medscape.com/features/casechallenges, public web pages); code and sample data at https://github.com/makogirls/GPT-medscape-case-challenge

notes: Snapshot not named; alias resolved by the post-2024-07 rule. Full question set must be re-scraped from Medscape (content changes over time). Clinician comparison is not needed for the model number.

resolution.plan: Check whether the repository's 'sample datasets' contain the 1,426 scraped case-challenge questions (2011 to June 2024) with answer keys; otherwise re-scrape the publicly accessible Medscape case challenges with the repository's scraper. Run gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 text-only with the Table 3 template at temperature 0.1, top_p 1.0, one fresh chat per question, and compare accuracy with 82.1%.
resolution.approximation: A re-scraped set differs from the 2024 snapshot (cases added or removed), so the comparison is at the set level; scraping must respect Medscape's terms.
